_note: Alfred Code 2.0.0 by its README route, non-interactive: the pinned release cloned from this repo's own tag; the official marketplace, then the stack's marketplace added from that clone (key envoydev) and the core alfred-code@envoydev installed from it at project scope - BEFORE the installer, which reads the stack's marketplace key off the installed core and would otherwise register the published envoydev/alfred-code; the selection a user gets by taking every recommended option of /alfred-code:setup for the fixture's four stacks (bench/lib/recommended.js, run on the release's own scripts); the installer at project scope; then /alfred-code:init, the one-time bootstrap setup's closing card ends on, which runs the captures the install carries (related projects, architecture, code style, agent capabilities). No capture prompt of its own: 2.0.0's setup names init, never a capture, and init refuses to re-run a done one. B4 checks the selection against a real setup walk, and that init completes its captures in print mode, where its asks cannot be answered.
